plots.title: Nikhil Clings to Narrow Lead
plots.text: Nikhil leads Matt by just 1 point, 723 to 722, after a 24-point cushion a week ago. Deepak sits 15 back, and the lead has changed hands 3 times this season.
plots.next: Matt could overhaul Nikhil again, with Deepak lurking 15 points behind.
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

plots.title: Vanessa Edges Back Ahead
plots.text: Vanessa has swapped places with Ravi Mahtani 7 times this season and now leads by 5. A week ago Ravi was 7 points clear, so the tide has turned again.
plots.next: Ravi Mahtani could hit back, and this rivalry shows no sign of settling.
plots.question: Vanessa v Ravi Mahtani: who blinks first?

plots.title: Alia's Long Dip
plots.text: Alia has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. This week she scored 50, up from 42, but the run is still going.
plots.next: One strong week could break the streak, or another dip could stretch it further.
plots.question: Can Alia snap out of it?

plots.title: Prem Cuts Rohan's Lead
plots.text: Prem has closed Rohan's lead from 34 points in GW7 to just 5 in GW10. The gap has shrunk every week since the chase began.
plots.next: If Prem keeps this pace, Rohan could be caught before the season ends.
plots.question: Can Prem catch Rohan?

plots.title: Rohan's Captaincy Crown
plots.text: Rohan has won Captain of the Week 5 times this season, setting the bar for everyone else. The rest of the league is still chasing that record.
plots.next: Could someone else finally break Rohan's grip on the captaincy award?
plots.question: Can anyone match Rohan?

group.text:
*Matt's 96 puts the title on a knife-edge!*
Matt's Bench Boost hauled 96 and he sits just 1 point behind Nikhil.
Ravin and Lakshay's armbands both returned just 2, while Pishu's N.Jackson captaincy hauled 22 for Pishu alone.

storylines.title: The summit squeeze
storylines.text: Nikhil leads Matt by just 1 point at the top, with Deepak 14 further back. The top spot is genuinely up for grabs.

storylines.title: Bench Boost bragging
storylines.text: Matt's 96-point Bench Boost is the week's best haul and has lifted him into contention for the title.

storylines.title: Armband agony
storylines.text: Ravin's Rogers and Lakshay's Palmer both returned just 2, while Pishu's N.Jackson captaincy hauled 22.

piece.headline: MATT'S BENCH BOOST BITES, NIKHIL HANGS ON BY ONE
piece.standfirst: Matt's chip turned a title chase into a one-point scrap, and Haaland's blank hurt 15 captains.
piece.big_picture: Nikhil was 24 clear a week ago. Now he leads by a single point, with the lead changed hands 3 times this season. This is no longer a procession. Matt has the momentum, Nikhil has the nerve test.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan ignored the crowd and put the armband on Barry. It brought 32 against the 4 that Haaland's captains got. A 28-point swing, and the bravest call of the week.
piece.one_to_watch: Nikhil against Matt, with just 1 point between them. Nikhil has led for 3 weeks, but Matt has the form. If either of them backs the wrong captain, the lead could flip again.

winners.name: Matt
winners.verdict: 3 weeks above average, and the climb from 7th is now a proper charge. Not a one-week fluke. Nikhil will be checking his mirrors.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: The only manager brave enough to back Barry with the armband. Brave, lucky or both? The league will say lucky. Hishaan will say visionary.

winners.name: Inesh
winners.verdict: Tzolakis, started by nobody else, quietly paid off. Isak in as a signing, too. Sensible week, and sometimes sensible is the cheeky move.

losers.name: Ravi Mahtani
losers.verdict: Worst week of the season, and the Wooden Spoon to show for it. Vanessa has snatched the bragging rights back. The tide keeps turning.

losers.name: Rohan
losers.verdict: 5th-time Captain of the Week winner, yet this time the armband went to Haaland too. The man who knows captaincy got it wrong.

ratings.line: Backed Barry alone. Brave, bold and vindicated. Insufferable until at least Tuesday.

ratings.line: Tzolakis for 6 points. A goalkeeper nobody else fancied came good.

ratings.name: Amit

ratings.name: Chandru
ratings.line: 23 points benched. Fix that and the top is in reach again.

ratings.name: Prem
ratings.line: Quiet, steady, and still creeping up on Rohan. Watch this space.

ratings.line: Konsa captain, alone. The idea was fine. The bench ruined it.

ratings.name: Nikhil
ratings.line: 5 weeks above average. Still only one point of cushion at the top.

ratings.name: Naresh
ratings.line: Isak and Groß in, and a third straight week above average. Sneaky progress.

ratings.name: Poonam
ratings.line: Evanilson captain brought 18. Slightly under average, but a respectable shout.

ratings.name: Pishu
ratings.line: N.Jackson as sole captain returned 22. Lone-wolf captaincy at its best.

ratings.name: Deepak
ratings.line: Barry in, 17 benched. A big week left some points behind.

ratings.name: Ravi Bhojwani
ratings.line: Bench Boost played, still 24th in the table. Chip came too late to rescue anything.

ratings.name: Sahil
ratings.line: Down to 12th. A drift downwards that needs arresting before it becomes a habit.

ratings.name: Vanessa
ratings.line: B.Fernandes came good, and nobody else owns him. Cheers for the lone ranger.

ratings.name: Aashiv
ratings.line: Third week below average. The slide from the top 6 is now a habit.

ratings.name: Bella
ratings.line: 8 under average with nothing to hide behind. A week to forget.

ratings.name: Sunny
ratings.line: Rice cost a hit, and the hit won the Transfer Flop. A pricey lesson.

ratings.name: Lakshay
ratings.line: Rayan, Raya and Barry in. 19 on the bench. A busy week, to little effect.

ratings.name: Vinesh
ratings.line: Another week near the foot of the table. Getting comfortable down there.

ratings.name: Alia
ratings.line: 6th week below average. Better than last week, but the streak lives on.

ratings.name: Ravin
ratings.line: Transfer Genius and 4th place in one week. Football can be cruel.

ratings.name: Rohan
ratings.line: 4 weeks ago Rohan was third. The captaincy king needs a new trick.

ratings.name: Ravi Mahtani
ratings.line: Worst week of the season, and the Wooden Spoon to prove it. Vanessa will be delighted.

preview.headline: Gameweek 11: Nikhil must hold off Matt

points.label: Armband dilemma
points.text: Haaland has been captained by 15 managers but scored just 2, so 4 for each captain. Calafiori's 12 for Nikhil and Prem is worth considering.

points.label: Injury sweat
points.text: Gvardiol, owned by 9 managers, is 75% to play. Manzambi, owned by 5, is also 75%, so check team news before the deadline.

column.headline: Matt's Bench Boost muscles into the title race
column.text: Matt's 96-point Bench Boost was the week's best haul and has pushed him from 5th to 2nd, just 1 point behind Nikhil at the top. Nikhil held firm on 73, but the summit squeeze is now real. Ravin's armband flopped again, with Rogers managing just 2, and Lakshay's Palmer returned the same, while Pishu's N.Jackson captaincy hauled 22 and Hishaan's Barry hauled 32 for his only captain. Deepak sits 14 back in third, so the top spot is genuinely up for grabs.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Barry Gamble
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan was the only manager to captain Barry, who scored 32 points and paid off the gamble. Hishaan climbed from 21st to 13th while 15 managers backed Haaland.

title.title: Nikhil Clings to Narrow Lead
title.text: Nikhil leads Matt by just 1 point, 723 to 722, after a 24-point cushion a week ago. Deepak sits 15 back, and the lead has changed hands 3 times this season.
title.next: Matt could overhaul Nikhil again, with Deepak lurking 15 points behind.

rivalry:4922092-5682768.title: Vanessa Edges Back Ahead
rivalry:4922092-5682768.text: Vanessa has swapped places with Ravi Mahtani 7 times this season and now leads by 5. A week ago Ravi was 7 points clear, so the tide has turned again.
rivalry:4922092-5682768.next: Ravi Mahtani could hit back, and this rivalry shows no sign of settling.

gold.title: The Gold Spot Cliffhanger
gold.text: Matt is the last manager in the 4 Gold spots, with Chandru first out just 3 points behind. Matt has spent only one of the last 5 weeks in the zone, while Chandru has spent 2.

chase:4487775.title: Prem Cuts Rohan's Lead
chase:4487775.text: Prem has closed Rohan's lead from 34 points in GW7 to just 5 in GW10. The gap has shrunk every week since the chase began.
chase:4487775.next: If Prem keeps this pace, Rohan could be caught before the season ends.

chase:3029346.title: Matt's chase tightens
chase:3029346.text: Matt has cut Nikhil's 37-point lead from GW7 to just one point now. The gap has shrunk every week, and the next gameweek could settle it either way.

slump:6051923.title: Alia's Long Dip
slump:6051923.text: Alia has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. This week she scored 50, up from 42, but the run is still going.
slump:6051923.next: One strong week could break the streak, or another dip could stretch it further.

award:captain:3344797.title: Rohan's Captaincy Crown
award:captain:3344797.text: Rohan has won Captain of the Week 5 times this season, setting the bar for everyone else. The rest of the league is still chasing that record.
award:captain:3344797.next: Could someone else finally break Rohan's grip on the captaincy award?
